_comment: Performance-regression bars for the gaia-agent eval (T5 tier, plan section 2b). Same posture as tests/fixtures/email/perf_gate_thresholds.json: 'enforce' ships FALSE (report mode) until the bars are calibrated against the first committed runner baseline — the values below are deliberately generous placeholders, not measurements. Token/cache metrics come from Lemonade usage counters and are self-hosted-runner-only; the local Claude validation run reports turn/tool counts and wall time only.
_gating: All keys are GATING bars when enforced. A metric the run could not measure must be reported as 'not measured' by the perf report, never rendered as a pass.
